definitions.explanation: Used when making a sincere request or plea.
Used to express uncertainty about whether something is the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧、どうか⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
どうかお⟦{許|ゆる}し→許す：02325_yurusu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧どうか⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know whether it's true or not.

notes:
どうか has two main uses:

MEANING 1 - PLEASE:
Used to make earnest requests or pleas. More emphatic than ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ alone.
- どうか⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: Please listen
- どうかお⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧します: Please, I beg you

MEANING 2 - WHETHER:
Used with verbs to express uncertainty.
- 〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧どうか: whether or not
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧どうか⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: I don't know if they'll come

SIMILAR:
- ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧: please (offering/permission, less urgent than どうか)
